constraints.description: The default installation path fetches the matching UAR release's immutable skill-system commit from a public HTTPS repository and rejects any mismatch.

validation.validation_method: Public shallow fetch of the exact pin plus wrong-commit installer control

constraints.description: The installer preflights Rust, performs the canonical locked release build, and activates only a complete version by same-filesystem rename.

validation.validation_method: Real public clone/build/install plus deterministic clean-prefix and build-failure replays

constraints.description: UAR detects the installed version without a development checkout and exposes the exact 147-skill default loader inventory through the skills API as built-in origin, while imported skills retain their existing opt-in boundary.

validation.validation_method: Clean-home server-full integration test requiring 147 discovered skills and comparing exact discovered and API ID sets

constraints.description: The change is limited to the HTTPS submodule URL, installer and focused tests, installation documentation, OpenSpec, and evidence, with phase Tier 2 deferred.

validation.validation_method: Scoped diff audit, Bash/ShellCheck, Tier 0, focused Tier 1, strict OpenSpec, schema, formatting, and diff checks

global_rules: Use the OpenSpec proposal, delta, and tasks as acceptance authority.
Do not silently bootstrap Rust, use sudo, or execute an unverified source commit.
Do not change the runtime's established installed-plugin precedence.
Report server-full macOS and the pack CLI build separately; do not run phase Tier 2 early.
termination_conditions: Strict OpenSpec, schemas, real and deterministic install checks, focused API test, formatting, and scoped diff checks pass.
Independent artifact critic and judge find no implementation or evidence blocker.
